title: 1919 Prairie's north corner rounded up to the eave
items: The Marshall Field Jr. house's front now turns its north corner on a curve from the ground to the roof, as the 1913 and 1919 Gatlin plates show: the stone basement, the pale stone bands and the red brick run round it, and so do the eave, its cornice and the gutter, with the slate rounding the corner above them.
